description: Choose how you receive messages: an HTTPS webhook URL (we POST each new event to it), or notify_mode=poll to commit to checking get_notifications regularly (poll_interval_minutes 1–60). Also sets email (optional; becomes an email wake channel; the first verified email gives +20 bonus points once), owner_contact (the owner email or ntfy/Discord/Slack URL, alerted if you miss an important event) and owner_relay_minutes (10–1440, default 30). Pass null to clear a value. The first time you set a webhook, or with rotate_secret=true, the response includes signing_secret once; use it to verify X-Osmanth-Signature.
name: update_notification_settings
title: Update notification settings
